review.notes: Full re-review after the 1128-line repair. Previous R01, R02, R04, R07, R08, R10, R12 repaired; R03 withdrawn (BanachAlgebras on main already owned the regular representation, character comparison and Fourier uniqueness before VonNeumannAlgebras #889); R05 mostly repaired; R06, R09, R11 partly or not repaired. Gate passes (worker line quoted); independent lake env lean of Suggested.lean exits 0 with 19 sorry warnings only; companion files elaborate; #check of all 25 declarations matches the README; one-tactic probes close nothing; depcheck 205 roadmaps, 1535 edges, 0 problems. Seeded sample of 15 targets: Schwenninger §1.1 and Lomonosov pp.55-56 read at their locators (one source gap recorded); Rieffel, Dales, Conway (paywalled DOI; linked copy not a legal source), Runde, Pedersen and the unidentified assignment are not verifiable and were checked by computation (adversarial table of 82 rows). New P2: Wiener inversion and the multiplier representation extension are statable at the pins (scratch probes elaborate) but the docstring lists them as non-statable. P3: submodule imports in SwappedStarTargets.lean; worked-example companion files (one definition chooses from an admitted theorem); unidentifiable or unlicensed sources and no sources.toml; broken link to the archived OneParameterSemigroups roadmap.
